title: 第9章 萌生杀意你开脉了第10章 玄级极品祖父突破
slug: 无敌帝祖第620章一剑杀了
content_zh:
林晨很快就走出清幽山。
嘴角微微扬起。
他一路走来，发现清幽山多了很多身影。
想来是之前修炼引来天地异象，这些人应该是为此而来。
他倒不在意，朝着天元镇走去。
……
“爹！
爹！
不好了，晨哥哥不知道去哪里了？”
林雨菲满脸担忧。
她连续修炼一夜，修为依旧没有突破融血境迹象。
刚走出房间，就见到清幽山方向的天地异象，就想要去叫上林晨一起看。
哪知道。
她来到林晨的房间，却没有见到对方。
“嗯？”
林毅闻言，眉头微微拧起。
他可是很清楚林晨的性格，别看他无法开脉，自尊心很强。
未曾开脉，必然对他打击很大。
“雨菲，叫上大家，一起去寻找。”
林毅没有迟疑，当即就叫上众人，就要朝着林家外走去。

“这小子该不会去清幽山吧？”
林明义看向清幽山方向的异象，脸色顿时变得难看起来。
若是让刘家的人在清幽山遇见林晨。
到时候说不定林晨要吃亏。
想到这里。
老爷子身上灵力流动，朝着清幽山方向迅速而去。
林晨眼看着来到天元镇外的街道。
放慢脚步，朝着小镇走去。
“哎哟！
这不是林大少爷吗？”
就在他还没走出几步。
迎面就走来几个少年，年龄都与林晨相仿。
说话之人尖嘴猴腮的模样，长着一张长脸，两只眼睛很小，几乎只剩下一条缝隙。
他就是刘家家主刘畅次子，刘柯。
兴许是整个家族的遗传，其他的几个少年，眼睛也长得很小。
content_en:
Lin Chen quickly walked out of Qingyou Mountain.
The corners of his mouth raised slightly.
Along the way, he found that there were many more figures in Qingyou Mountain.
It seems that the previous practice caused strange phenomena in the world, and these people should have come here for this reason.
He didn't care and walked towards Tianyuan Town.
…
"Dad!
Dad!
Sorry, I don’t know where Brother Chen went? "
Lin Yufei's face was full of worry.
She practiced continuously all night, but her cultivation still showed no sign of breaking through the blood-melting realm.
As soon as I walked out of the room, I saw a vision of heaven and earth in the direction of Qingyou Mountain, and I wanted to call Lin Chen to watch it together.
No idea.
She came to Lin Chen's room, but didn't see him.
"Huh?"
Hearing this, Ji Yi frowned slightly.
He knew Lin Chen's character very well. Even though he couldn't open his pulse, he had a strong sense of self-esteem.
He has never had a pulse, so it must have been a huge blow to him.
"Yufei, call everyone and let's go look for it together."
Ji Yi didn't hesitate, he immediately called everyone and walked towards the outside of Lin's house.
"Is this kid going to Qingyou Mountain?"
Lin Mingyi looked at the vision in the direction of Qingyou Mountain, and his face suddenly became ugly.
What if the Liu family met Lin Chen in Qingyou Mountain?
Lin Chen might suffer a loss then.
Think of this.
The spiritual energy in the old man's body flowed and he quickly moved towards Qingyou Mountain.
Lin Chen looked at the streets outside Tianyuan Town.
Slow down and walk towards the town.
"Ouch!
Isn't this Young Master Lin? "
Just before he took a few steps.
Several teenagers walked towards him, all similar in age to Lin Chen.
The speaker has a long face with a sharp mouth and monkey cheeks, and his two eyes are so small that there is almost only a gap left.
He is Liu Ke, the second son of Liu Chang, the head of the Liu family.
Perhaps it is a hereditary trait of the entire family, as several other teenagers also have very small eyes.
